culprit_citations.quoted_text: Senior Secured Loans - First Lien | Fair Value 4,575,722 | 12.4%
A business development company, such as the Company (BDC)

findings.detail: Vehicle type BDC was treated as PRIVATE_CREDIT even though the source schedule shows only 13.0% private credit and 63.1% common plus preferred stock.

rationale: Class 3 aggregate strategy validation. The filing confirms that the company is a BDC, but its March 31, 2026 portfolio composition shows senior secured loans at 12.4% and corporate bonds at 0.6%, totaling 13.0% private credit. Common stocks are 31.9% and preferred stock is 31.2%, together 63.1%, against total invested assets of 36,753,538. Therefore the PRIVATE_CREDIT strategy derived solely from vehicle_type=bdc is inconsistent with the raw portfolio mix; the flag identifies a real classification error rather than a bad mix check.
